items.title: Staff/Principal Developer Advocate
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. THE ROLE... Synthesia's API and platform capabilities are quickly becoming the way developers embed AI video into their own products — automated training pipelines, localization workflows, customer-facing apps, and more. We're looking for our first Developer Advocate to make sure the developer world knows it, understands it, and gets building. This is a builder-and-storyteller role. You'll be the face and voice of the Synthesia API to the outside world — writing, coding, speaking, and showing up wherever developers already are — while also being the internal champion who brings their feedback back into the product. You won't just talk about what's possible with Synthesia; you'll build the sample apps, tutorials, and demos that prove it, and you'll do it consistently enough that developers start to recognize your name before they recognize the logo. You'll be part of the Developer Services team and work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Developer Support to turn technical capability into developer adoption. WHAT YOU'LL DO Create technical content that developers actually use - Write blog posts, tutorials, and how-to guides that show real, working integrations — not just feature announcements - Build and maintain sample apps, starter kits, and code snippets across common languages and frameworks - Produce video walkthroughs and livestreams using Synthesia's own product wherever it makes sense to "eat our own dog food" - Keep a fast, honest cadence — regular, dependable output builds more trust than occasional big launches Show up where developers are - Represent Synthesia at conferences, meetups, hackathons, and webinars — as a speaker, workshop host, and booth presence - Run livestreams and community AMAs that go deep on real implementation questions, not marketing talking points - Build relationships with individual developers, technical bloggers, and community leaders who influence adoption - Travel as needed to be physically present in the communities that matter most to our growth Be the credible technical voice - Get hands-on with the Synthesia API well enough to build things yourself, debug alongside developers, and speak with authority — not from a script - Earn trust the way any evangelist does: by being genuinely useful before asking for anything in return - Play the long game — plant seeds in developer communities today that turn into adoption months or years down the line Close the loop with product - Channel developer feedback, friction points, and feature requests back to Product and Engineering in a structured way - Partner with Developer Support and Documentation to identify where the API's rough edges are creating support burden or lost adoption - Help prioritize the developer experience roadmap based on what you're hearing on the ground Build the flywheel - Grow and nurture channels — Discord/Slack community, developer newsletter, social — where developers can find each other and find help - Identify and cultivate community advocates and early power users who can become case studies, co-speakers, or contributors - Measure what's working (content engagement, API sign-ups, community growth, sentiment) and adjust the playbook accordingly ABOUT YOU... - Experience in developer relations, developer advocacy, technical evangelism, or a similar hybrid technical/communication role — ideally at a platform, API-first, or infrastructure company - Genuinely hands-on: comfortable writing code, working with APIs and SDKs, and building demo apps yourself, not just narrating what engineering built - A strong, authentic communicator across formats — written, live, and on stage — who can make technical concepts land with a developer audience - Comfortable with regular travel and public speaking; energized by meeting developers in person, not just online - A track record of sustained output (blog, video, or community content) rather than one-off campaigns — evangelism is a long game, and consistency is what earns trust - Skilled at listening as much as broadcasting: you can sit in a developer's frustration and turn it into a clear, actionable signal for the product team - Comfortable operating with a lot of autonomy in a fast-moving, still-forming function - Bonus: existing following or credibility within a developer community relevant to Synthesia's platform (video, AI/ML, automation, or enterprise software) THE GOOD STUFF.. In addition to being a part of a great team, working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer: - A competitive salary + stock options in our fast-growing Series E startup - Hybrid working environment or remote friendly - 100% Medical, Dental & Vision - 401k Plan - Paid parental leave - 25 days of annual leave + Public holidays + paid sick leave - Fun culture with regular socials - A generous referral scheme - A brand new computer + monitor - Budget and support for conference travel, community events, and content production

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency. Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization. In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic - Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication - Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows - Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes - Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time - Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results - Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems - Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards. WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment - Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems - Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making - Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD - Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards - Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders - You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document - A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics - Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English NICE TO HAVES - Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications - Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack - Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning - Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring - Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection - Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. items.title: Head of Enterprise Risk Management
items.description: About the Team The OpenAI Risk & Audit team is building an enterprise risk capability for a company operating at the frontier of AI. We help leaders identify, understand, and manage the risks that matter most while enabling responsible innovation and durable growth. We are developing a modern enterprise risk management (ERM) program and the technology foundation that powers it. Our work connects risk strategy, governance, compliance, and assurance with high-quality data, automated workflows, continuous monitoring, and AI-enabled analysis. We partner across Finance, Security, Legal, Engineering, Product, People, Operations, and Internal Audit, and provide clear reporting to senior leadership and the Board. We aim to make risk ownership practical, decision-useful, and embedded in how OpenAI builds and scales. About the Role As the Head of Enterprise Risk Management, you will help build and lead an integrated ERM program and the ERM platform that supports it. You will establish common risk language, governance, and decision processes while translating them into scalable systems, data products, and workflows. You will own enterprise risk assessments, maintain a centralized risk register, develop risk appetite and key risk indicators, and help leaders evaluate significant changes such as new products, markets, partnerships, major systems, and strategic investments. This is a senior individual contributor role for a hands-on leader who will build our ERM capability from the ground up, with the potential to build and lead a team over time. You will work with technical and business teams to connect source systems, improve data quality, automate evidence and control monitoring, and use AI to surface emerging risks and accelerate analysis. You will also help create a strong risk culture, coordinate assurance across the three lines, and communicate complex issues with clarity and sound judgment. This is an opportunity to build a next-generation capability from the ground up. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Design and evolve OpenAI’s enterprise risk management framework, including risk taxonomy, governance standards, risk appetite, escalation thresholds, and mitigation expectations. - Lead enterprise risk assessments and maintain a centralized, decision-useful risk register that reflects strategic, financial, operational, technology, security, compliance, and emerging risks. - Establish key risk indicators, continuous-monitoring capabilities, and executive dashboards that translate complex data into clear signals, trends, and actions. - Enable risk-informed change governance for new products, markets, partnerships, acquisitions, major systems, and other high-impact initiatives. - Lead effective governance forums working cross-functionally with key partners such as Compliance, Finance, Security and others, and prepare concise reporting for senior leadership and the Board. - Define the strategy and roadmap for a modern ERM platform that will connect with systems across the enterprise including identity, finance, HR, ticketing, code, and others through reliable integrations and shared data models. - Apply automation, policy-as-code, data analytics, and AI-assisted workflows to evidence collection, control monitoring, issue management, risk analysis, and audit or regulatory responses. - Coordinate risk activities across Finance, Security, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Operations, and Internal Audit, clarifying ownership and reducing duplication across the three lines of defense. - Build, coach, and lead a high-performing team, strengthen first-line ownership, and foster a culture of practical risk management, curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 12+ years of experience across enterprise or operational risk, compliance, internal audit, security governance, finance, or related fields, including significant experience leading ERM or GRC programs. - A track record of building or materially scaling an enterprise risk program in a fast-growing, technology-driven, or otherwise complex global organization. - Strong command of ERM and assurance practices, including risk appetite, risk assessments, KRIs, controls, issue management, and the three-lines model; familiarity with frameworks such as COSO or ISO/IEC 27001/27017/27018/27701/42001. - Experience advising executives and presenting risk information to senior governance bodies, with the judgment to make complex tradeoffs clear and actionable. - Technical fluency with GRC platforms, data architecture, APIs, system integrations, cloud environments, and automated workflows; experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, or policy-as-code is a plus. - Experience using data analytics, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve risk sensing, evidence analysis, control monitoring, and reporting. - The ability to connect strategic, financial, operational, technology, security, and compliance risks and to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. - Demonstrated success hiring, coaching, and developing multidisciplinary teams while operating effectively in ambiguity and at high velocity. - A relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; credentials such as CIA, CPA, CISA, CRMA, CRM, or an advanced business, legal, or technical degree are valued. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: Software Engineer, Native Mobile
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Mobile, to accelerate our development of fully native apps for iOS and Android. Today our apps wrap the web app; you will replace them with native Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose apps, harnessing AI to deliver a new refined and polished mobile experience. You will be responsible for setting strong technical foundations for these new codebases. You will: Build the apps Build and ship native iOS and Android apps in Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose. Ship user-facing features end to end: search, AI assistant, agents, notifications, and OS integrations such as widgets, App Intents, share extensions, live voice modes and more. Build experiences that feel native on each platform, following Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and Google’s Material Design, with strong accessibility, performance, and offline behavior. Define the mobile architecture: module boundaries, networking, persistence, concurrency, observability, and performance budgets. Build the infrastructure Own mobile CI/CD: automated builds and tests, code signing, TestFlight and Play Store deployment, phased rollouts, and release health monitoring. Set up an AI-native development workflow: an agent-friendly repo, automated test generation, AI-assisted review, and tooling that lets coding agents build, run, and verify mobile changes. Own enterprise readiness Build, sign, and ship enterprise app variants with their own configuration and distribution requirements. Own mobile authentication end to end: OAuth 2.0/PKCE, OIDC/SAML SSO, secure token and session handling, and identity-provider policies such as conditional access and device trust. Make the apps work in managed and BYOD environments: MDM, MAM, managed app configuration, app protection policies, and Android Enterprise work profiles. Design admin-controlled data protection (downloads, sharing, copy/paste, screenshots) with Security and Admin teams, and emit reliable audit events for customer security tooling. Represent mobile in enterprise security reviews and validate behavior on real managed and unmanaged devices. About you: 6+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years shipping production mobile apps on both iOS and Android. Proficiency in Swift or Kotlin with working knowledge of the other, and willingness to develop cross-platform fluency, as you will be responsible for both iOS and Android. You have owned mobile CI/CD pipelines and release infrastructure (e.g. Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions, Gradle, code signing, staged rollouts). You use AI coding tools daily to ship faster without lowering the quality bar, and have opinions on structuring a codebase and toolchain so agents work in it effectively. Experience with mobile auth: OAuth 2.0/PKCE, OIDC/SAML, MSAL, ASWebAuthenticationSession / Custom Tabs, Keychain and Android Keystore. Experience shipping OS integrations (widgets, App Intents / Shortcuts, extensions, background work) on at least one platform. Startup mindset: comfortable owning problems end to end, from infra to pixels, in an ambiguous environment. Nice to have: migrating a hybrid or cross-platform app to native; shipping in MDM/MAM-managed enterprise environments. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office) Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $265,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . That takes high-quality data and evals that teams can trust. Our team owns data and evaluation science for Glean's AI products. We build evalsets, agentic LLM-judges, and benchmarks that capture what good looks like, along with the platform and infrastructure that run evals reliably at scale, and enterprise simulation environments where we test how our assistants and agents actually perform. Build and scale the eval platform and agent observability: experiment pipelines, trace capture and replay, and dashboards, with reproducible, affordable runs. Build agentic LLM verifiers for correctness, groundedness, citation quality, and task success, and calibrate them against human labels using clear rubrics. Run evals at every stage, from CI and pre-release suites to sampled production traffic, and report results with confidence intervals. Build enterprise simulation environments with simulated users and realistic company data to test multi-step agent tasks. Diagnose failures by slice and trace, and turn eval results into concrete fixes, weighing quality against latency and cost. Through our selling approach and world-class enablement programs , we equip our team with the tools, resources, and training. This is how we keep delivering meaningful results for our customers. Reporting to the Chief Sales Officer of Semrush and partnering with Regional Vice Presidents of Sales , this leader will own the global CS strategy, operating model, leadership development and performance, with accountability for adoption, value realization, retention, renewals and expansion. This is not a Support or Professional Services role. We need a product-deep, commercially driven leader who builds exceptional teams, engages credibly at C-suite level and translates Semrush and Adobe Brand Visibility capabilities into measurable business impact. Our customers don't simply buy technology; they invest in outcomes. The mandate is to make Customer Success a strategic growth engine, connecting our platform, data and insights to executive priorities and turning customer value into durable, profitable growth. The Mandate Accelerate time-to-value and measurable business outcomes. Deepen adoption and maximize platform value. Drive retention and predictable renewals. Unlock expansion through demonstrated customer impact. Elevate executive engagement and strategic partnerships. Build one globally consistent CS operating model with exceptional leadership, talent and execution. This leader will own the enterprise customer journey from closed-won through value realisation and renewal readiness, driving accountability across Enterprise Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Support, Professional Services, RevOps, Enablement and Adobe field teams. Key Priorities 1. Build one global Enterprise CS operating model Define how Enterprise CS should operate globally across regions, account tiers, product lines, and customer complexity. Install consistent operating rhythms across onboarding, adoption, customer health, renewal readiness, executive engagement, and risk management. Create clarity on what good looks like: what CSMs own, what Sales owns, what Renewals owns, when SE or Professional Services gets involved, and how we engage executives at the right moments. 2. Shorten time-to-value Own the customer journey from closed-won through first measurable value. Every enterprise customer should have a clear success plan tied to what they bought, why they bought it, who needs to adopt it, and what outcome they expect. Build onboarding standards by product and customer complexity. Set expectations early, remove friction quickly, and ensure customers realize value with speed and confidence. 3. Drive deeper product adoption Raise the bar for how Enterprise CSMs understand and drive adoption across the broader Semrush portfolio. This team needs to be product-deep enough to understand workflows, use cases, adoption blockers, stakeholder gaps, and where customers are not getting the value they should. The goal is not activity. The goal is adoption connected to customer outcomes. 4. Improve retention and renewal readiness Build a disciplined Enterprise renewal readiness motion in partnership with Sales and Renewals. Improve visibility into customer health, adoption quality, risk, executive alignment, and value realization well before renewal. Create clear risk categories, save plans, escalation paths, and executive engagement standards. No surprises. No late risk discovery. No renewal conversations without a clear view of value. 5. Elevate executive customer engagement Move QBRs and EBRs from usage reviews into strategic business conversations. Enterprise customers should understand how Semrush helps them answer bigger questions: what is working, what is not, where to invest, where competitors are winning, how customer journeys are changing, and how visibility connects to action. This leader will raise the quality of executive engagement across the Enterprise CS team. 6. Build strong cross-functional operating discipline This role sits at the center of Customer Success, Enterprise Sales, Renewals, Product, Solutions Engineering, Support, Professional Services, Enablement, RevOps, and Adobe field teams. Deep product orientation, with comfort going below the surface into workflows, use cases, adoption barriers, and value realization. Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance customer advocacy, retention, expansion partnership, and revenue accountability. Operating discipline across scorecards, inspection cadence, customer health, renewal risk, and executive reporting. Experience leading managers and scaling a global or multi-region CS organization. Clear communication and executive presence, with the ability to simplify complexity across teams, customers, and regions. Professional Traits (your bar) Excellent Judgment - high-quality, timely decisions with incomplete data; owns outcomes. Hire & Develop the Best - raises the bar; builds managers as force multipliers. High Standards - precision in pipeline, forecast, messaging, and execution. Strategic + Hands-On - ability to effortlessly toggle between strategic direction-setting and operational rigor, with a skew towards action. Innovator’s Bias - turns market trends and customer pain into product and GTM plays. Ambitious & Conviction-Driven - sets bold goals; mobilizes teams to beat them. Results-Oriented - grit and tenacity - measures what matters; celebrates outcomes, not activity. Inspirational Leadership - creates clarity, energy, and momentum across regions. items.title: Cybersecurity Engineer – Data & Betting Platforms F/M
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As a Security Engineer, you will join Betclic’s Global Security team as a member of the Cybersecurity Referents team. You will work directly within squads responsible for authentication, identity and payment journeys. You will act as an embedded security partner throughout the product lifecycle, from initial design and architecture discussions through implementation, security validation and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on role combining application security and architecture analysis. When relevant, you will also perform pragmatic offensive security testing. You will help teams identify relevant risks, implement effective security controls and deliver secure, reliable and user-friendly experiences. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Your role will be to strengthen security across several business and technology domains at Betclic, with a focus on Data and Sports Betting. Working closely with Developers, Architects, Product Managers and Engineering Managers, you will: Conduct secure design reviews and threat modeling for new projects, providing pragmatic and actionable recommendations. Assess existing implementations—including source code, APIs, data flows and security controls—to identify vulnerabilities and opportunities for improvement. Identify realistic attack paths affecting critical business journeys and validate them through controlled security testing or proof-of-concept exercises when useful. Work with teams to implement security improvements, promote secure development practices and share reusable security patterns. Propose, lead and contribute to security initiatives that reduce risks across the Data domain and your assigned business domain. Collaborate with the wider Security organization, including the Blue and Red Teams, as well as Compliance and Fraud teams. Why join this role? Strengthen security across Betclic’s Data activities and a strategic business domain. Work directly with teams and influence security from architecture through implementation. Bring your software development experience to practical application security challenges. Help teams implement meaningful security improvements, rather than stopping at recommendations. Develop broad expertise across application security, data security, secure software engineering and business domains. Work collaboratively with the wider Security organization in an international environment. TECHNOLOGY & SECURITY LANDSCAPE 💻 Application security: Threat modeling, secure design reviews, source code and API reviews, and controlled security testing. Data security: Data flows, access rights, data exposure risks, and security controls for data processing and sharing. Technologies: You will encounter C#, Rust, Kotlin, Dart and Flutter. Experience with one or more of these technologies is an advantage. Secure delivery: CI/CD security controls, SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning and secrets management. Business context: Experience working with data platforms , online betting or gaming products systems is a plus. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! This job is for you if you: Have 3–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on securing applications or digital products. Have experience working directly with Product and Engineering teams in an agile environment. Have a solid understanding of software development practices and the challenges developers face. Are comfortable analyzing both security architecture and implementation details. Understand the security principles behind modern authentication and identity systems. Are proactive and able to identify, propose and drive security improvements. Can communicate effectively with developers, architects, product managers and business stakeholders. Have experience with web and API security. Cloud experience with AWS or Azure is a plus, but not required. Are fluent in English. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 If your application is shortlisted, Sebastien or Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will meet Philippe, Senior Security Referent Manager. About two weeks later, you will take a technical test with one of our Security experts. Finally, Sebastien or Maxime will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux (remote from another city possible depending on profile - on-site presence required twice a month). Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.title: Data Center Hardware Engineer
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE MISSION You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters. Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure. You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (H100/H200-class and next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond. Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end. Location: On-site at one of our data center in Bessé-sur-Braye, Pays de la Loire. items.title: Member of Data Staff (Data Acceleration)
items.description: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. This role brings that same standard to how our data team works, with AI at the center of everything we do. We're looking for someone who's been a great data scientist, analytics engineer, or data engineer: the kind of person who knows which metric actually matters, can design an A/B test that answers the real question, has gone deep on a data model because something didn't add up, and has decided that the highest-leverage thing they can do next is build AI systems that fundamentally change how data science gets done. You'll build AI agents and internal systems that can increasingly handle end-to-end analysis workflows: forming hypotheses, writing and running queries, interpreting results, and drafting recommendations with the right evaluation, review, and guardrails. You'll build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let AI systems query the warehouse reliably. You'll create workflows that detect, diagnose, and help fix data issues before they become company-wide problems. You'll build the infrastructure that multiplies what a small data team can ship. You'll join a data team that's already using AI across its work. The next step is turning those individual workflows into scalable systems, shared tools, and an AI-native operating model that becomes a benchmark for how modern data teams work. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build AI agents that do data science - not just SQL copilots, but systems that can safely explore data, form hypotheses, run queries, interpret results, and generate actionable recommendations with clear evaluation and human review loops. - Make AI systems query the warehouse reliably - build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let agents use our semantic context and metadata accurately. - Accelerate the AI-native data workflow - turn the best existing AI-assisted workflows into repeatable systems, reusable tools, and patterns the whole data team can adopt. - Automate the data lifecycle - build self-healing pipelines, automated dbt model generation and validation, data quality agents, and diagnosis workflows that reduce manual firefighting. - Ship AI-powered experiment analysis - build agents that interpret A/B test results, flag statistical issues, identify likely drivers, and draft ship/no-ship recommendations. - Turn the data team into a product team - build internal data products that stakeholders use every day, replacing ad hoc requests with self-serve AI interfaces. - Own the full lifecycle - identify high-leverage problems, prototype with LLMs, evaluate accuracy, design the UX, ship to production, and monitor quality over time. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in data science, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role. You've been close enough to real data work to know what should and should not be automated. - Deep SQL and analytics judgment - you can reason through metrics, experiments, data models, and messy warehouse reality without relying on a tool to think for you. - Strong product sense - you understand what stakeholders actually need, what makes a workflow adoptable, and how to turn a prototype into a product people use. - Hands-on LLM experience - you've built with frontier models, agents, RAG systems, evals, or AI-powered workflows and have opinions about where they work and where they fail. - Pipeline and modeling fluency - you've worked with dbt, warehouse schemas, data quality issues, and the practical tradeoffs behind durable data systems. - Builder mentality - you see a manual process and immediately think about how to systematize it. You ship fast, measure quality, and iterate. - Autonomy - this is a new function. You'll help define the roadmap as much as execute it. BONUS - Experience building production AI agents or agent evaluation systems. - Experience with Snowflake, semantic layers, or metadata systems. - Experience building internal tools, Slack bots, CLIs, or developer productivity products that people actually used. - Strong experimentation background, including metric design and statistical interpretation. - Experience with BI tools and the judgment to know what should be automated versus kept human-reviewed. - Early-stage startup experience. WHY THIS ROLE - Set the standard for the industry - Perplexity's data team is already using AI across its work. You'll turn that into something other data teams look to as the benchmark. - Build AI with AI - Perplexity builds AI for people who expect more. You'll bring that same level of ambition to how the company works with data. - Frontier models, day one - you're at an AI company with access to frontier infrastructure and people who deeply understand what's possible. - Massive leverage - the systems you build will multiply the output of every data team member and every stakeholder who needs data. - Direct impact - small team, no layers of approval. Idea to shipped system in days, not quarters.

We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Robinhood Advisor Products team is bringing Trade PMR, Robinhood's newly acquired registered investment advisor platform, into the Robinhood product suite. Our multiyear mission is to connect Robinhood's growing retail customers with Trade PMR's financial advisors, while bringing together two sets of technology and user experiences into one coherent product. You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and partners in marketing and finance who care about getting this integration right for customers on both sides. We're energized by the scope of this work and the chance to shape how two strong businesses come together! As a Staff Web Engineer on this team, you'll build and scale full-stack systems, spanning backend services and web applications that support Advisors and Investors. You'll take on system design work, reasoning through tradeoffs to produce architecture that holds up as the integration between Trade PMR and Robinhood grows, and you'll stay hands-on, writing code while also setting technical direction. You'll partner with product, marketing, and finance stakeholders to turn open-ended requirements into concrete technical plans, and you'll coach and review other engineers' work to raise the bar on quality and process across the team. You'll have an initial focus on integrating "growing good" retail customers with Trade PMR advisors. This role is based in our New York, NY office(s), with in-person hybrid attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Design and build full-stack web systems, backend services and user-facing web applications. Create system and technical designs that hold up at scale, and reason through tradeoffs with your team before committing to an approach. Partner with other engineering teams, product, marketing, and finance stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans. Coach and review other engineers' work, helping raise the bar on code quality, design rigor, and delivery practices. Define mechanisms to ensure best practices are applied in our development cycle. Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including customers when needed, about progress and tradeoffs. What you bring 10+ years of professional engineering experience, with several years at the staff level and prior Team Lead experience Hands-on experience building and scaling web systems, with strength in React, TypeScript, and Node, plus proficiency in Go and Python. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Connector Ecosystem team builds the platform and product experiences that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, skills, connectors, interactive apps, and open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We make plugins easy to discover, install, and use, ensure they’re invoked at the right time, and help people find new ways to get value from them. We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work spans creation and publishing, reliable execution across our products, clear permissions and approvals, and the controls admins need to bring plugins to their organizations. We work closely with research to improve tool quality as models evolve. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a product-minded Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction, build the systems behind plugins, and improve how models use them. Depending on your focus, you may scale generalist infrastructure and identity-related integrations across products, improve plugin quality at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, or work on the product experience itself to drive plugin usage. You’ll lead complex initiatives across teams and own problems from diagnosis and design through implementation and release. You’ll remain hands-on while driving product and design decisions alongside Product, Design, Research, and engineering partners. You’ll help shape what we build and how it works, translate user and developer needs into clear priorities, and guide technical decisions that balance rapid iteration with long-term reliability and maintainability. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Set technical direction and lead complex initiatives across the Plugin Ecosystem, aligning architecture and execution across teams. - Drive product and design decisions with cross-functional partners, helping define priorities and shape intuitive experiences for users and developers. - Design and ship APIs, SDKs, and services that developers use to extend ChatGPT and Codex. - Build intuitive experiences that help users discover, install, and use plugins to get more done. - Make plugins easier to create, test, publish, update, and share. - Improve when and how models use plugins, from choosing the right plugin to completing a task. Work with Research to diagnose failures and measure improvements as models evolve. - Improve plugin reliability and interaction quality across ChatGPT and Codex, including interactive apps, with clear error messages and recovery paths. - Build consistent permissions, approvals, and admin controls that help individuals and organizations confidently adopt plugins. - Work with developers and partners to turn recurring problems into improvements to the platform, tooling, and documentation. - Collaborate across engineering, Product, Research, Security, and Trust & Safety to scale plugin infrastructure and deliver safe, reliable execution. - Raise the engineering bar through mentorship, thoughtful code reviews, and clear technical guidance. Experience with identity, permissions, or integration-heavy systems is especially valuable. - Enjoy talking with users and developers, understanding what they’re trying to accomplish, and turning recurring problems into product and platform improvements. - Can move between product questions and technical details, collaborate across teams, and take an ambiguous problem through to production. - Are comfortable working across web interfaces and backend systems. items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team brings Claude to organizations doing some of the world's most important work across the nonprofit and education sectors. These organizations share a problem: mission-critical work, thin budgets, and little slack to figure out new technology on their own. Our Customer Success team helps them go from first login to Claude being part of how their teams work, but we cannot do that one organization at a time, nor should we. The sector already has trusted intermediaries these organizations turn to first: networks, capacity builders, funder technical assistance providers, community colleges, and fellowship programs. This role exists to make those intermediaries as effective at activating and training organizations on Claude as our own Customer Success team is. As the Scaled Enablement Lead, you'll build the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program that qualifies intermediaries to onboard organizations and deliver Anthropic-designed workshops on our behalf. You'll own the kits, credentials, and quality gates that let them run the show without an Anthropic CSM in the room. You'll also own the enablement thinking behind scaling impact through Claude Corps : how what fellows learn and build serves every organization we support, not only the ones that host them. The people you enable are not selling Claude. They are trainers, implementers, and program staff whose job is to help mission-driven organizations meaningfully adopt AI. Your job is to make sure these intermediaries can do that with Claude, to the same bar we hold ourselves to, and to help them evolve their offerings as we learn what these organizations need. The measure of success for this role is organizations activated and trained well without Anthropic delivering it. You'll be half program builder, half facilitator. You'll design and deliver the first cohorts yourself, then make the system repeatable: kits, qualification paths, credentials, teach-back gates, and a refresh rhythm that keeps content current as our products change. You'll build on the operating model and certification infrastructure of Anthropic's Education team and own everything specific to this audience, working closely with Beneficial Deployments Customer Success, Partnerships, Claude Corps program leadership, and our Education teams. This is not a partner account management or alliances role, and it carries no quota. It is not a book-of-business Customer Success role either, though you'll spend time with organizations to stay grounded in what these nonprofits truly need. The role reports to the Customer Success Lead for Beneficial Deployments, has no direct reports today, and may grow into people management as the program scales. Expect periodic travel for in-person cohorts and sessions. Key responsibilities: Own the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program end to end: its tracks, the qualification path for each, the credential, and recertification Build the kits intermediaries teach from: an activation playbook covering kickoff, admin setup, launch, and Day 30/60/90 reviews, and workshop-in-a-box modules starting with AI fluency and use case discovery, each with a deck, facilitator guide, demo scripts, sample data, and workbook Recruit and qualify a pilot cohort of anchor intermediaries, then open a repeatable application process that routes each to the right track and the right home, whether the Claude Partner Network or a Beneficial Deployments credential Design and deliver enablement for network intermediaries, adapting the program to how each reaches and supports its members, and help them evolve their offerings as we learn what organizations need Build the connective tissue among intermediaries so they learn from each other: shared office hours, a facilitator cohort that stays together after qualification, and a clear path for bringing new intermediaries along Support the enablement thinking for Claude Corps: how we extend the reach of fellows and the organizations around the program, and how what they learn feeds back into the enablement every customer receives Hold the quality bar when Anthropic is not in the room through teach-back gates, graded mock sessions, shadowing, and session satisfaction and activation quality at or above Anthropic-led benchmarks Run the program as one system: content intake and refresh calendar, production standards, resource hub organization, learning management system courses and assessments, and the agreement and attribution model for intermediaries acting on Anthropic's behalf Own the program's numbers, including approved trainers, collaborator-led activations and workshops, the Anthropic effort required per organization activated, and quality against benchmark, and use them to decide where the effort goes next Be the field voice for intermediaries inside Anthropic, bringing what they learn back into our enablement content, product feedback, and engagement model Minimum qualifications: 7+ years of experience in enablement, training, or program management Train-the-trainer at scale. Learning design and delivery. You have designed adult learning experiences end to end, including curriculum, facilitator guides, and assessments, and delivered them live Nonprofit ecosystem fluency. You have worked with or inside the intermediaries that reach mission-driven organizations (networks, capacity builders, funders, technical assistance providers) and understand how they influence adoption Hands-on proficiency with AI tools. This role reports directly to Kraken's Chief Sanctions Officer and sits at the heart of how we review, escalate and resolve sanctions risk across Kraken's global footprint. items.title: Head of Retention
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, and retention is one of the most important unsolved problems in the business. Traders come in for elections, crypto moves, and playoff runs, then go quiet. The gap between a one-time depositor and an active, long-term trader is where this role lives. You will build and lead the team that closes it. The retention org today is early. You will design the structure, make the hiring calls, and build the operating model from the ground up, including lifecycle, CRM operations, retention analytics, and incentives. You will manage through managers, own the incentive P&L with Finance, and be the voice of the retained trader in executive forums. This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a playbook. The playbook does not exist yet. This hire matters because retention is now a company-level priority, not a marketing function. Active-trader retention and LTV are going into the company scorecard. The person in this role will sit in leadership reviews, shape product roadmaps, and make the call on where incentive dollars go. If you have built a retention org at a high-churn consumer business, know how to run incrementality tests, and want to work on a product that is genuinely hard to retain users on, this is the job. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build the retention organization from an early-stage team into a full function, including lifecycle, CRM operations, analytics, and incentives, and make the calls on when to hire, what to build in-house, and what to bring in from partners. - Own active-trader retention at 30, 90, and 180 days and LTV growth as company-level KPIs, and report cohort performance, churn signals, and incentive ROI directly to the CEO and exec team. - Set and defend the retention incentive budget with Finance, using incrementality data to make the hard calls on when spend is and is not worth it. - Align Markets, Growth, Product, and Brand around a single coordinated plan for major event moments, including elections, playoffs, and crypto events, so acquisition and retention move together. - Negotiate roadmap commitments from Engineering and Data for the triggers, tooling, and data infrastructure the retention team needs to operate, including Braze, Customer.io http://Customer.io, and Amplitude. - Own messaging rules across the company, including frequency caps and channel priority, to resolve competing demands for user attention and protect the trader experience. - Work with Legal and Compliance as a peer to set retention guardrails covering CFTC rules, state eligibility, and contact permissions, so the team can move fast inside clear limits. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 10 or more years in retention, lifecycle, or CRM, with at least 5 years leading teams and direct experience managing managers. - A track record of building or scaling a retention org at a high-churn consumer business, in sports betting, fintech, streaming, or a comparable category. - Experience owning an incentive or retention budget with full ROI accountability, including presenting incrementality results to Finance and executive leadership. - Strong analytical judgment: you can challenge a model, design or read an incrementality test, and explain the results clearly to people who are not specialists. - Experience presenting to and influencing a C-suite on retention strategy, not just reporting metrics. - Experience leading in a regulated industry, with working knowledge of compliance constraints on user communications and promotions. - Genuine interest in markets, sports, politics, or crypto, because the product is event-driven and the team needs to care about what traders care about. - (Plus) Direct background in sports betting or prediction markets, with familiarity with how bettors churn and what actually brings them back. - (Plus) Experience operating in a CFTC-regulated or similarly regulated environment. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

items.title: Researcher, Misalignment Monitoring Lead
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI's Safety Research organization works to ensure that our most capable AI models can be deployed safely and responsibly. As frontier models become increasingly capable and autonomous, developing reliable ways to monitor their behavior, identify emerging risks, and evaluate the effectiveness of safety systems becomes increasingly important. Our work focuses on advancing the research and evaluation methods needed to understand model behavior and ensure that monitoring systems remain effective as model capabilities evolve. We combine rigorous empirical research with practical safety interventions, working closely with research, engineering, and deployment teams to translate findings into improvements across OpenAI's models and products. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a senior researcher to lead technical work on misalignment monitoring for frontier AI systems. You will develop methods to evaluate the effectiveness of AI monitors, understand their limitations, and improve our ability to detect and stop concerning model behavior reliably. This role combines research leadership with hands-on technical execution. You will set research priorities, design rigorous evaluations, investigate monitoring failures, and develop approaches for stress-testing and improving monitoring systems. A key focus will be understanding where monitors produce false positives, miss important behaviors, or become less effective as models grow more capable. You will work closely with researchers and engineers across OpenAI to turn monitoring research into practical improvements to our safety systems. We are looking for someone with strong research judgment, technical depth, and the ability to independently drive ambiguous problems from initial investigation through measurable results. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Lead the research and technical direction for evaluating and improving the misalignment monitoring of frontier AI systems. - Design and execute rigorous evaluations that measure monitor effectiveness, identify failure modes, and assess the reliability of monitoring signals. - Develop methods to stress-test and red-team monitors, including identifying behaviors that evade detection or expose weaknesses in existing approaches. - Investigate false positives, missed detections, and other monitoring failures to improve the accuracy and usefulness of safety evaluations. - Build scalable evaluation frameworks and experimental tools that enable ongoing measurement of monitoring performance as model capabilities evolve. - Translate research findings into actionable improvements, working with partner teams to strengthen monitoring systems and inform broader safety decisions. - Establish research priorities and guide technical execution, balancing foundational research questions with practical deployment needs. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have a strong background in machine learning research, particularly in model evaluations, AI safety, alignment, robustness, or related areas. - Have demonstrated the ability to lead technically challenging research projects, from identifying important questions through designing experiments and delivering results. - Bring strong experimental judgment and understand how to design evaluations that are rigorous, reproducible, and difficult to game. - Have hands-on experience building or evaluating machine learning systems, including working with large language models or other frontier AI systems. - Enjoy investigating complex failure modes and developing methods to distinguish meaningful safety signals from misleading measurements. - Are comfortable working on open-ended research problems where the right methodology or success criteria may not be obvious at the outset. - Combine strong research instincts with practical engineering ability and can independently build experiments, analyze results, and iterate quickly. - Communicate technical findings clearly and enjoy collaborating across research, engineering, and safety teams. - Are motivated by OpenAI's mission and the challenge of developing reliable oversight mechanisms for increasingly capable AI systems. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with AI monitoring, automated evaluations, adversarial testing, or red-teaming. - Research experience in scalable oversight, AI control, model behavior analysis, or interpretability. - Experience developing monitoring or evaluation systems that are used in real-world deployments. - A track record of technical research leadership, including mentoring researchers or coordinating cross-functional research initiatives. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
