items.title: Regional Research Economist, Economic Research
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Regional Research Economist at Anthropic, you will collaborate with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region to measure and understand AI’s effects on the economy and explore research-driven policy interventions. You will contribute to the development of the Anthropic Economic Index and its extension to generate regionally relevant insights, establish new methodologies to measure the usage, diffusion, and impact of AI throughout the economy, and work to broaden access to and usage of the insights generated by the Index. You will use frontier methods in econometrics, machine learning, and structural estimation. Such rigor will drive impact, shaping both policy discussions externally and informing Anthropic’s internal business and product decisions. Our team combines rigorous empirical methods with novel measurement approaches. We’re building first-of-its-kind datasets tracking AI’s impact on labor markets, productivity, and economic transformation. Using our privacy-preserving measurement system ( Clio ), we analyze millions of real-world AI interactions to understand how AI augments and automates work across different occupations and tasks. For this role, we’re looking for candidates who can combine rigorous economic analysis with novel measurement approaches to understand AI’s transformative effects on the economy. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working at the intersection of empirical economics, technological change, and policy impact. Key responsibilities Build and maintain relationships with academic institutions, policy think tanks, and other research partners as the primary point of contact for these organizations on economic impact work in your region Advance research collaborations that answer country- or regional-specific economic impact questions Translate research insights into actionable recommendations for policy discussions Make fundamental contributions to the development and expansion of the Anthropic Economic Index , including country- and regional-specific analysis Design and collaborate on empirical research on AI’s economic effects with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region Develop new methodological approaches, in collaboration with partners in your region, for studying AI’s impact on labor markets and the future of work; productivity and task transformation; economic inequality and displacement; industry-specific disruption and adaptation; and aggregate economic trajectories (GDP, productivity, unemployment) under varying AI-adoption scenarios Work cross-functionally with other technical teams to improve our measurement infrastructure and data collection Amplify external engagement through research publications, policy briefs, and presentations to diverse stakeholders Minimum qualifications PhD in Economics Strong track record of empirical research, particularly studies combining novel data sources and economic theory or implementing frontier methods in causal inference and machine learning Demonstrated experience working in, and relevant relationships across, the region Proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar tools for large-scale data analysis Demonstrated ability to lead complex research projects from conception to publication Demonstrated ability to communicate technical findings to diverse audiences Demonstrated ability to build relationships across academic, policy, and industry communities Preferred qualifications Experience relevant to the study of AI’s impact on the economy, such as labor market analysis and occupational change; task-based approaches to technological transformation; large-scale data analysis and econometric methods; large language models for social science research; policy-relevant economic research; experimental and quasi-experimental methods for causal inference; macroeconomic modeling and time series forecasting; or agent-based modeling and large-scale simulation Experience working with novel datasets and measurement systems Comfort learning new technical tools and frameworks Strong interest in ensuring AI development benefits humanity Comfort working with AI systems and ability to think critically about their capabilities and limitations Representative projects How Australia Uses Claude: Findings from the Anthropic Economic Index Anthropic Economic Index Report: Economic Primitives Anthropic Economic Index Report: Uneven Geographic and Enterprise AI Adoption Estimating AI productivity gains from Claude conversations The Anthropic Economic Index Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Engineering - Internal AI Transformation
items.location_text: London, Dublin, New York, Germany, Poland, Sweden, Italy, Poland, United Kingdom, Canada, Berlin
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. The role / impact As an Internal AI Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be embedded at the frontier of how we scale - acting as a forward-deployed engineer across our GTM, Operations, and Finance teams. You won't just build tools; you'll co-design and ship agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people operate. Your impact goes beyond the code. You'll own high-stakes automations from discovery to production, acting as a technical partner to internal teams. The patterns, guardrails, and tooling you define will become the blueprint other teams reach for - the standard for how ElevenLabs harnesses AI safely and at speed. The team / how we work You'll join a lean, high-velocity team with a shared obsession: turning broken, manual processes into elegant automated systems. We move fast through rapid experimentation, work closely with operators and business owners to uncover the real problem, and ship pragmatic solutions without waiting for perfect specs. What you'll actually be working on - Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like ElevenAgents, Claude, and n8n. - Integrating AI systems with our core business stack - Salesforce, Slack, Ashby, and more - Building reusable automation services, patterns and shared templates that multiply the output of every team you touch - Owning experiments end-to-end: spotting the opportunity, building the solution, and measuring the impact - Developing evaluation and monitoring frameworks so our AI-native workflows are reliable, auditable, and safe What we're looking for - Proven experience building and shipping automations or applications in production - you know what it takes to go from fuzzy business pain to something real teams depend on - AI-First Instincts: Strong familiarity with LLM capabilities, prompting strategies, RAG patterns, and a genuine passion for building agentic workflows. - Deep Backend Expertise : Strong Python and SQL and system design patterns (APIs, webhooks, orchestration layers) - A systems-thinking mindset : you design with security, auditability, and blast radius in mind from the start - Builder and AI-First instincts: you don't wait to be told what to build - you spot the pattern, propose the fix, and ship it. - Infra & DevOps Instincts: Hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), Kubernetes, Docker, and enterprise authentication flows LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. Specific teams may have specific location preferences. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. The Team: Fanatics Gift Card Business sells over 200 different gift cards through tens of thousands of ecomm and physical stores in more than 10 countries, serving our clients’ fandom aspirations around gifting, self-rewarding, and business needs — and materially scaling it is a strategic priority for the company. The Global Gift Card Team operates as a high-velocity, entrepreneurial unit inside Fanatics, with the agility of a FinTech startup backed by the infrastructure of a global sports platform powerhouse: a highly collaborative, cross-functional team transforming, shaping, and scaling the business into a high-growth global acquisition engine, grounded in proactive ownership, creative problem-solving, and a shared passion for connecting sports fans worldwide to the brands they love. items.title: Software Engineer, Identity Infrastructure
items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle
items.description: About the Team The Identity Infrastructure Engineering team builds the identity and access systems that OpenAI’s researchers, engineers, and internal teams rely on to protect critical systems and data. We partner with Research, Applied Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and Security to make secure access practical across cloud and internal environments. About the Role We’re looking for a hands-on software engineer to design and build high-scale, high-throughput secure access proxies and the distributed systems behind them. These are tier-zero services: researchers, engineers, and agents depend on them to reach critical infrastructure safely and reliably. You’ll work at the intersection of networking, distributed systems, and infrastructure security, building the serving paths and control-plane integrations that connect identities to resources. Teleport is a core part of the current platform; the role also includes credential brokers, policy enforcement, and developer-facing integrations. You’ll own the services you build from design and implementation through production. That means understanding human, agent, and workload traffic, improving throughput and tail latency, making authorization decisions auditable, and designing for safe multi-region rollout and recovery. We’re looking for someone who can turn a demanding security requirement into software that works well at scale and is straightforward for other engineers to use. In this role, you will: - Design and implement secure access proxies, gateways, and credential brokers that provide narrowly scoped, auditable access to infrastructure and internal services while reducing standing privileges.. - Integrate identity and access policy across clients, proxies, and target systems so approved permissions take effect promptly and access expires or is revoked when required. Ensure correct behavior when policy is stale or sessions remain active. - Build observability that explains the end-to-end access path: latency, errors, saturation, authorization decisions, and identity attribution, without leaking credentials. - Engineer safe multi-region rollouts, canaries, rollback, failover, and recovery. Validate changes with realistic test environments, load tests, and failure testing. - Keep core access services reliable, performant, and maintainable. Own production support, maintenance, upgrades, and incident recovery; ship durable fixes that reduce recurring failures, alert noise, and manual work. - Make secure access easy to adopt through reusable APIs, client tooling, diagnostics, and self-service workflows. Lead migrations that preserve critical workflows, with tested rollback and recovery paths and clear ownership across Infrastructure, Security, and SRE. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have built and operated production backend, proxy, networking, or infrastructure services with demanding scale or availability requirements. - Have practical networking depth and can reason about HTTP, TCP, TLS, DNS, routing, and load balancing across real request paths. - Can explain how you handled performance bottlenecks, partial failures, multi-region deployment, or a difficult production change in a system you personally built. - Understand authentication, authorization, least privilege, trust boundaries, credential handling, and the consequences of an access-control failure. - Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience with Go, Rust, Python, or similar languages. - Use tests, profiling, telemetry, and reproducible experiments to debug across system boundaries and verify correctness, performance, and recovery. - Make practical scope decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and follow through from code to production. Teleport or comparable access-platform experience is helpful; strong engineering and production ownership matter more than knowing every tool. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.title: Product Designer, AI-Native Products (Staff-Level / L6)
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. THE ROLE: We're looking for a Staff (L6) Product Designer to lead design for some of Synthesia's AI-native, agentic Sessions product surfaces. Sessions are the experiences where employees learn through conversation, companies lrun a survey at scale, and AI becomes a direct participant in how work gets done - not just a tool behind the scenes. This area is central to redefining what a video platform can be: moving upstream from content creation into workforce development, and making complex AI capabilities feel natural, trustworthy, and effective for everyday users. You'll operate as a senior IC: setting direction, influencing roadmap decisions, shaping bets with Product and Engineering leaders, and raising the craft bar. In practice, this role is about solving AI-native design problems, for example: - Designing real-time, conversational avatar experiences that feel engaging and natural - not robotic or gimmicky - for employees learning and practising skills at work. - Creating interaction patterns for AI-driven workflows that give users the right amount of control, transparency, and trust without overwhelming them with complexity. - Improving output quality through better structure, guidance, and feedback loops - helping users understand what the AI is doing, catch issues early, and iterate with confidence. - Working at the frontier where AI changes what "interaction" means, and the best patterns are genuinely still being invented. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: - Own major AI-native bets end-to-end, from problem framing to shipped outcomes and iteration. - Set a design vision for our "Sessions" surface, and influence adjacent product areas to stay coherent. - Partner closely with Product and Engineering to define what "great" looks like (principles, quality bar, success metrics) and then drive toward it. - Prototype and test interaction models quickly - including novel agentic and conversational patterns - and know when high-fidelity matters. - Raise the bar on craft: interaction design, UI quality, systems thinking, and consistency across AI-native experiences. YOU SHOULD APPLY IF YOU BRING: - Significant experience designing complex, high-usage product surfaces - ideally including AI-native products, agentic features, conversational interfaces, or products where the system takes meaningful autonomous action. - Strong craft in interaction design and visual design, and a track record of shipping work that measurably improves the product experience. - Comfort operating in ambiguity: you can turn unclear and fast-moving problem spaces into crisp direction, and you do not wait for perfect clarity. - Systems thinking: you understand how AI capabilities, model constraints, and product architecture shape what's actually possible in the UX - not just what looks good on a screen. - Excellent communication in design reviews and cross-functional decision-making contexts. - Experience designing workflows where trust, transparency, and user control are central - helping users feel confident in AI-driven outputs rather than confused or excluded. - A track record of tackling novel problems in maturing product spaces, and shaping the product from early-stage bets through to execution. - The ability to leverage feedback from users and customers to ensure the product continues to meet real needs - including enterprise users with high stakes around quality, compliance, and scale. AT SYNTHESIA WE EXPECT EVERYONE TO: - Put the Customer First - Own it & Go Direct - Be Fast & Experimental - Make the Journey Fun You can read more about this in this public Notion page: https://synthesia.notion.site/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2 BENEFITS - A flexible, remote friendly role based out of Europe or one of our hubs in London, Copenhagen, Munich, or Zurich. - 25 days of annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based. - A generous referral scheme. - Work from home set up. - At Synthesia, you can work from anywhere (within reason) in the world for up to 60 days per year! - A huge opportunity for career growth as you’ll help shape a market-defining product.

items.title: Talent Operations
items.location_text: United States, New York, San Francisco, Canada
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE Our Talent Operations team runs the machinery behind hiring at ElevenLabs: the systems, workflows and data that help us hire exceptional people quickly. We’re hiring at pace, with 200+ open roles across 40+ countries, and Ashby sits at the centre of all of it. We're looking for a hands-on Ashby expert who can turn hiring priorities into clean, working setups, so recruiters and interviewers can focus on candidates rather than the tool. You’ll be the person the talent team trusts to get the system right, and to know when something is quietly going wrong. Talent Operations works from first principles. We don’t ask how hiring has always been done. We ask how to make it the best possible experience for candidates, hiring managers, recruiters and everyone involved. Automation and AI drive everything we do, because we’re scaling our talent function without scaling headcount at the same rate. The goal is to maximize the impact each person on the team can have. To start, your time will be split as ~60% Ashby build and administration, ~25% scheduling support and Talent Ops projects, and ~15% data and reporting. WHAT YOU’LL OWN - Ashby go-to: be the first point of contact for Ashby questions from recruiters, interviewers, and hiring managers. Write the how-tos so the same question doesn’t get asked twice. - Interview plans: build and customize interview plans, stages, feedback forms and scorecards. Update them as roles and processes change, keeping structure consistent so data stays comparable across teams. - Jobs and postings. End to end: take approved headcount to a live, accurate job and posting quickly. That covers hiring teams, approvals, custom fields, job boards and postings across locations. Keep every job accurate through to close and archive. - Data quality: own ATS hygiene, including stage mapping, source attribution, rejection and archive reasons, department and team structure, and stale applications. Spot problems before they show up in a report. - Process and projects: support Talent Ops on process changes, tooling rollouts and projects that help the function scale, plus interview scheduling support during busy periods (or until we roll out agentic scheduling). IN YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS, YOU WILL: - Audit and standardize interview plans across ElevenLabs so pipeline data is comparable - Cut job setup time by templating common role types - Automate a manual workflow with AI or integration tooling - Improve interviewer capacity and assist with automating scheduling - Own 1-2 Talent Operations projects end to end REQUIREMENTS - Ashby Power User. Prior hands-on Ashby experience as an active, day-to-day user, including setting up jobs, postings, feedback forms, and interview plans. - Fast-paced Operations. Experience in recruiting operations or coordination in a fast-moving team. - Strong data hygiene instincts. Messy data bothers you, and you fix the root cause, not just the symptom. - AI native. Comfortable using AI tools to cut manual work and move faster. - Clear written communication. You can explain a system change to a hiring manager in two sentences. - Timezone: Able to work in United States timezone hours. BONUS: - Strong analytical and reporting skills. You’re confident building reports in Ashby and working with exported data in spreadsheets (pivots, lookups, basic formulas), and you can turn the numbers into a clear story about what’s working and what isn’t. - Scheduling at Scale. Interview scheduling at scale, including complex multi-timezone panels. - Project Management. Organized and able to run projects end to end with multiple stakeholders. YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF: - You enjoy being the person who knows how the system actually works - You’d rather build a template once than do the same setup ten times - You’re comfortable moving fast without letting accuracy slip LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally, with a preference for United States timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco. INTERVIEW PROCESS We are accepting applications through October 30, 2026. The Hiring Manager will review all applications and determine next steps. The interview process will be: - AI Interview - Meet the Hiring Manager - Case Study - Call with the Team - Final Interview #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing Paid Social marketing campaigns across multiple brands. You will play an important role in executing new campaigns and the wider strategy to grow the channel within our local structure for the UK & Ireland. You will be reporting directly to the Paid Social & Programmatic Lead, while working closely with other stakeholders in the UK&I Media team and across the wider UK&I cluster, including Marketing, Brand, Creative, AdTech teams and more. In order to drive successful campaigns, you will utilise all the latest solutions and tools from Paid Social platforms (including Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok, Reddit and similar). To succeed in this role, you need to be a self-driven and self-motivated individual - ready to work hands-on across multiple accounts. You will actively manage and optimise campaigns, whilst working closely with the team and expanding your digital marketing experience. The ideal candidate will be a positive and adaptable team player, with a problem-solving attitude, and good communication and presentation skills. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Executing and managing a wide range of Paid Social campaigns hands-on across multiple platforms (including Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok, Reddit and similar), for all verticals (casino, live casino, sports betting) and multiple brands. - Working closely with the team to analyse metrics from internal tools and platforms to track campaign performance and continuously optimise our accounts. - Implementing new channel solutions and running regular A/B tests across our activity, aligned with the overall goals and KPIs. - Building active collaboration with our key partners across external digital platform teams and tech vendors. - Navigating complex tracking and attribution systems with the Media team and AdTech teams to maximise our measurement capabilities across the channel and expand our incrementality testing. - Collaborating with Brand and Creative teams to ensure messaging and creatives are aligned across the funnel and utilise channel best practices. - Activating CRM data within our platforms to execute highly targeted segmentation strategies as well as drive lookalike modelling. - Staying ahead of platform updates, new ad formats, and emerging media opportunities. - Working closely with the Central Marketing teams to ensure alignment, consistency and best practice sharing across markets. - Ensuring full compliance with regional advertising regulations and other compliance standards. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: - 1-2 years of experience in Paid Social or wider digital marketing role (client side or agency). Gaming industry experience will be considered a plus. - Hands-on experience working with some of the popular social media platforms (Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok and/or Reddit). - Basic knowledge of Paid Social best practices - from a technical perspective, through performance delivery, to creative guidelines and tools. - Strong analytical mindset, confident in spotting opportunities for growth. Professional experience in using analytics tools will be considered a plus (Tableau/Looker, Google Analytics, Appsflyer or similar). - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. - Fluent English is essential for this role, both written and spoken. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: HR Manager
items.description: We’re looking for an experienced HR Manager to join and take ownership of our people and hub at Sporting Solutions. In this highly collaborative role, you’ll support and guide managers and employees across the full employee lifecycle, combining trusted day-to-day advice with hands-on delivery and continuous improvement. If you enjoy balancing people, business and operational priorities while creating an outstanding employee experience, this could be the role for you! The Wow You will play a central role in creating a positive, consistent and high-performing employee experience. Acting as a trusted partner to managers and employees, you will take full ownership of people processes and HR-related matters. This is a varied, hands-on role with the opportunity to influence how we attract, develop, reward and retain talent. You will also collaborate closely with the global HR team to move the people agenda forward and strengthen our processes and practices as we continue our journey to become the Employer of Choice. A taster of what you will be involved with: Coach and guide managers on people-related matters, helping them lead their teams effectively. Own competence and resource planning to support current and future business needs. Contribute to organisational design and development initiatives. Support recruitment and employer branding activities to attract and engage the right talent. Manage employment agreements and provide guidance on labour law matters. Support compensation and benefits processes. Coordinate social events and team-building activities that strengthen connection and engagement. Drive performance management processes and support managers throughout the performance cycle. Manage end-of-employment procedures in a consistent and professional way. Work closely with the global HR team to develop HR processes and practices that deliver an excellent employer experience. Support day-to-day office management and employee queries. Drive and participate in a range of local and global HR projects. What we are looking for: Broad HR experience with the confidence to take ownership of the full employee lifecycle. Strong coaching and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with managers and employees. Practical knowledge of employment agreements, labour law, performance management, compensation and benefits, and end-of-employment processes. Experience supporting recruitment, employer branding, organisational development and workforce planning. A collaborative, hands-on approach and the ability to work effectively with both local stakeholders and a global HR team. Strong organisational skills, sound judgement and the ability to manage competing priorities. A genuine commitment to creating an engaging and positive employee experience. Why Join Us? Take ownership of a broad and varied HR remit with the opportunity to make a visible impact. Work closely with managers, employees and a collaborative global HR team. Help shape people practices, strengthen the employee experience and support our ambition to become the Employer of Choice. Join a fast-paced, international environment where no two days are the same and where your ideas can make a real difference. Much like a rollercoaster, life at Betsson Group is fast-paced, full of twists and turns, and always exciting. With more than 2,800 colleagues representing over 75 nationalities across a global network of offices – including 1,500 at our operational headquarters in Malta – every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow. It may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you thrive on innovation, enjoy pushing boundaries and want to be part of a diverse, international team, then you’ll fit right in at Betsson. Challenge accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy.

items.title: Content Lead - Kraken Pro
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions. We offer spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, built for individual investors and institutions alike. Kraken Pro is where serious traders work. Tight spreads, deep books, an API people actually build on. Our audience is skeptical, technical, and quick to tune out anything that feels like marketing, so our content has to earn its attention. THE OPPORTUNITY We're looking for a Content Lead who can write the script, nail the headline, and shape the email in the same week. This is a broad, hands-on role across Kraken Pro: organic posts, organic and paid video, campaign copy, and email. You'll set the voice for how we talk to traders and make sure everything we put out sounds like it was made by people who trade. - Write for every format. Scripts for organic and paid video, copy for organic posts, and the occasional longer piece when an idea needs room. - Own the idea, not just the words. Turn a brief into a concept traders would actually watch or read, then carry it through to the final cut or the send button. - Run campaign copy end to end. Headlines, ad copy, landing pages, and email campaigns, from product launches to trader lifecycle journeys. - Translate the Kraken Pro voice into words and dialogue. Sharp, credible, never salesy. Make order types, funding rates, and liquidity clear without dumbing them down. - Move at market speed. Turn around reactive content for volatility, listings, and launches, with clear sign-off so speed never costs accuracy. - Partner across the business. Work with Social, Community, Video, Design, Product, and Marketing, plus the traders and product experts who know the platform best. - Increase and improve output by actively integrating AI wherever it helps. Ideation, drafts, repurposing. Faster output, same voice. - Learn from the numbers. Track what gets watched, opened, clicked, and converted. Double down on what works and drop what doesn't. - Ship responsibly. Work with Legal and Compliance so everything we publish is accurate and compliant across regions. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - Receipts. A portfolio of scripts, campaigns, and emails that performed. We care more about what the work did than who it was for. - 4+ years in content, copywriting, or social-first marketing in fintech, crypto, or trading, and comfortable owning the work end to end. - You speak market. Funding rates, order types, liquidity, volatility. You can make them watchable and readable without dumbing them down. - Range. You know a punchy video hook, a scroll-stopping post, and a high-performing email are different crafts, and you can do all three well. - A campaign brain. You can go from brief to concept to execution, and explain why an idea works in two sentences. - Channel fluency. You know how YouTube, X, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and the inbox each reward content, and you write for them, not around them. - Speed and judgment. Markets don't wait. You know when something can ship now and when it needs a second pair of eyes. - High AI competency. You use it to move faster and make better work, not just more of it. - Thick skin. You've made content for traders who are quick to call out anything that feels like marketing. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

items.title: Office Manager - FTC 12 Months
items.description: *This position is a 12 month Fixed Term Contract covering Maternity Leave* Based in the heart of Manchester, Betable Group are a team with knowledge and dedication to both online gaming and fintech solutions. We are responsible for delivering top-class online gaming experiences for customers of over 100 online casino and bingo sites both in Great Britain and internationally. Betable also have our own cutting-edge iGaming platform which hosts an array of casinos which enables them to operate as well as an exciting new payment solution which handles high volumes of payment transactions. As we are a fast-paced business, the office manager will keep the workplace running smoothly while supporting the CEO & HR team where needed and handle our product packing & logistics for a small business, Little Ox Limited. This role requires 4 days per week in the office to manage physical operations. This position is well-suited for individuals who are organised, proactive, and at thrive in a fast-paced working environment. Key Responsibilities Manage and order food, fridge, and snack stock for the office. Ensuring the office is clean and tidy at all times Greet visitors and clients while coordinating appointments. Oversee all incoming deliveries and outgoing post. Liaise with the building manager for any office-related issues. Book and coordinate external contractors for office maintenance. Deliver general administrative support including preparing letters and documentation. Provide diary assistance, meeting coordination, and ad hoc support to the CEO. Arrange all business travel and book accommodation. Managing dinner and other ad hoc reservations for the company. Arrange company dinners and social events. Act as the primary point of contact for the IT provider to resolve issues. Handle product packing and dispatching for the "Little Ox" side of the business. Manage product customer service inboxes, refund requests, and questions. Post on product social media and answer direct messages. Conduct regular product stock takes. Provide administrative management and oversight for business projects. Assist the HR team and wider business as and where needed. Provide occasional out of hours support to the C-Suite, which may include evenings and weekends when required. Be a reliable and dependable individual who can be trusted to manage tasks and responsibilities effectively. Any other business (AOB) duties as required. Essential Skills High level of flexibility and adaptability is essential. The aptitude to build relationships across all levels of the business including senior management and executives, as well as external contacts. Proven experience in a similar role Full comprehension of office management systems and procedures. Excellent knowledge of MS Office. Proficiency in English. Exemplary planning and time management skills. Ability to multitask and prioritise daily workload. High-level verbal and written communication skills. Discretion and confidentiality. Full UK Driving Licence essential. Working Hours · Monday – Friday, 9.00am – 5.30pm · Monday – Thursday in the Manchester Office, Friday WFH Flexibility is needed based on the Company needs, occasional out of hours support required.
